title: Citrine - In East Nashville - Mins to Germantown
description:
Welcome to Citrine, your vibrant Nashville retreat just minutes from Germantown’s top eateries. Unwind in the open-concept living area with cozy furnishings, a fireplace, and a Smart TV, then whip up meals in the fully equipped kitchen. Drift off in the king suite or let the crew bunk together in fun bunks before catching live music on Broadway, cheering at a Titans game in Nissan Stadium, or sampling local brews at East Nashville Beer Works. Citrine is your sparkling Music City base.
